comparison: v1.1 shearing source, superseded smooth v1.2 source, and restored multiscale v1.2 source at matched source-plane samples
scope: Emitted source-plane intensity and analytical/local scalar presentation sensitivity only. These measurements do not compare NASA imagery, full rendered detectors, retarded-image mixing, lensing visibility, encoded video or Instagram recompression. All fluctuation scales are illustrative, not measured turbulence or a GRMHD validation.

reproduction.requires: Python, NumPy and the identified source files; no videos, render cache or previous comparison report

metric_definitions.relative_intensity: B(r,phi,t)=J(r,phi,t)/J_background(r), using the common peak-normalized exterior Page-Thorne background
metric_definitions.angular_variance_by_mode_band: rFFT of B-1 divided by N; twice squared amplitude at nonzero, non-Nyquist modes, with DC and Nyquist not doubled; band sums have Parseval variance units
metric_definitions.radial_structure_function: mean over matched emitted times, uniform azimuth and geometric radial midpoints of [B(r*exp(delta/2),phi,t)-B(r*exp(-delta/2),phi,t)]^2; endpoints remain inside the common domain
metric_definitions.tone_relative_sensitivity: For fixed g, x=g^4*J/.02 and y=x/(1+x), dln(y)/dln(J)=1/(1+x). Listed sensitivity examples set J=1, not a measured detector radiance
metric_definitions.tone_compressed_source_plane_metrics: At each actual sampled J(r,phi,t), set illustrative g in {.3,.5,.7,1}, compute x=g^4*J/.02 and y=x/(1+x); record mean(y), std(y)/mean(y), range and percentiles before palette/RGB encoding. No detector g is inferred
metric_definitions.shutter_retention: For cos[m(phi-Omega*t)] with constant local Omega and ideal box exposure D, amplitude retention=sinc(m*Omega*D/2), sinc(z)=sin(z)/z. The three-point Gaussian source shutter approximates this integral
metric_definitions.cadence_limit: For constant-Omega circular advection at interval dt, m*Omega*dt<=pi is the local angular Nyquist guide; it is not a complete temporal convergence guarantee

superseded_smooth_equation_reconstructio.implementation: SupersededSmoothEmission in compare_kn_emission.py, with prepare/evaluate retarded-time interface for controlled visual comparisons
superseded_smooth_equation_reconstructio.parameters: m=(1,2,4), weights=(.3,.5,.2), kr=(.7,-3,2.1). Envelopes: m1=1; m2=.35+.65*smoothstep[(r-rISCO)/(.8rISCO)]; m4=smoothstep[(r-3)/2]. Seed default_rng(13326), uniform(-pi,pi), shape(32,3); m2 phases replaced by .45*sin(2*pi*j/32). smoothstep=3x^2-2x^3 with x clipped[0,1]
superseded_smooth_equation_reconstructio.captured_statistics_checked: All24 matched means, RMS, minima and maxima measured before replacement; numerical constants embedded in the helper

causal_findings: The superseded source had only three broad angular modes; m4 vanished below3rg, near the bright inner region. Its measured bright-peak RMS was much smaller than v1.1
The fixed display tone curve further compresses relative source contrast in bright regions; modest fluctuations can become nearly invisible
The half-frame source shutter retains about99.4% of m1 and97.5% of m2 amplitude at the mean-flux peak, so it is not the main cause of missing low-order texture
The restored positive angular-normalized packet mixture adds overlapping irregular radial supports and a coherent spiral while preserving the exterior Page-Thorne mean
At the matched bright-peak samples, the restored/superseded mean emitted RMS ratio is 5.967450; this measures source contrast, not rendered-image fidelity
Angular packet widths follow a declared local cadence guide; the gas frequencies and photon paths are unchanged
limitations: Emitted-time snapshots omit per-ray retardation. A rendered view samples different source times and directions at different pixels
Fixed-g tone metrics are controlled source-plane examples, not a detector prediction or RGB/compression assessment
Additional spatial-frequency power is not automatically more physical; source contrast, widths, coherence and periodic forcing remain prescriptions

Radial packet advection, radial phase gradients, birth crossfades, retarded-time gradients and viewpoint motion also affect temporal behavior; angular Nyquist limits alone do not establish full convergence
The captured smooth-source hash identifies a superseded intermediate file. Its explicit reconstruction is a comparison reference, never a production renderer source
This report does not change or validate thermodynamics, charged-plasma physics, photon paths, Page-Thorne flux, the flow or the chosen display exposure
